integrity: Reproducible exhaustive standard-library finite chain and symmetry checker; no external independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Finite 24-vertex categorical product only; rational natural D8 x S3 homology module and integral nonequivariant homotopy; no full automorphism-group or integral quotient classification. The 2023 paper already reports free homology for this example; equivariant decomposition is the present advance. Unindexed equivalent work is possible.
title: Dihedral and color-permutation homology of \(\operatorname{Ind}(C_8\times K_3)\)
